observations.namacalathus: Oxford museum nama.jpg actual specimen: eroded cup and rounded lateral rim remnants, central area partly infilled/obscured; stalk not visible. Shore2021 abstract and Fig1 captions at PubMed33523867 support stalked cup with six radial lobes/apical opening/lateral lumens. Missing stalk restored as illustrative fossil-form generalization, not claimed observable in museum photo; no living soft tissue. PubMed26538593 challenge not interacted with.
observations.piedmont-glacier: NPS actual Malaspina aerial: immense spreading white lobe with curved dark debris bands, constricted mountain outlet behind; material/color chosen artistically, no site dimensions copied.
observations.lava-channel: USGS actual17Aug2018 photo: high sharp uneven levee at left, lowered broken plate channel floor at right; inactive/cooling description inspected. No emission or current flow.
observations.karst-polje: Gams2005 page31 Photo1 and Photo2 actually inspected. Globodol from south shows elongated flat basin enclosed by relief, foreground vegetation masks some margins; Planina photo also broad flat floor and enclosing slopes. Definition on p27 inspected; no universal tectonic genesis asserted. No surface ponor or river modeled.
